fn:formatFasta.cost: O(bases) work; width is the number of bases per sequence line.
fn:formatFasta.failure: FastxError/Format (width outside 1..1000, or a read with an empty name), TooLarge (more than 1,000,000 reads, or output over 1 MiB).

fn:formatFastq.cost: O(bases) work; each read with a quality string is written as four lines.
fn:formatFastq.failure: FastxError/Format (a read with no quality, or with an empty name), LengthMismatch (sequence and quality lengths differ), TooLarge (more than 1,000,000 reads, or output over 1 MiB).

fn:parseFasta.cost: O(bytes) work; blank lines are ignored, CRLF is accepted.
fn:parseFasta.failure: FastxError/Format (sequence before the first header, empty header name, offset is the line number), TooLarge (input over 1 MiB, or over 1,000,000 reads).

fn:parseFastq.cost: O(bytes) work; each record is four lines, CRLF is accepted.
fn:parseFastq.failure: FastxError/Format (a line missing or not starting with @ or +, offset is the line number), LengthMismatch (sequence and quality lengths differ, offset is the header line number), TooLarge (input over 1 MiB, or over 1,000,000 reads).

fn:phred.cost: O(quality) work; offset is 33 (Phred+33) or 64 (Phred+64), and each byte is converted to its score.
fn:phred.failure: FastxError/Format (offset other than 33 or 64, or a byte below the offset, offset is 0), TooLarge (quality over 1 MiB).
